query: SELECT source,count() AS n,countIf(source='edge_logs' AND toInt32OrZero(log_attributes['response.status_code'])>=500) AS http5xx,countIf(source='edge_logs' AND toFloat64OrZero(log_attributes['response.origin_time'])>5000) AS over5s,max(if(source='function_edge_logs',toFloat64OrZero(log_attributes['execution_time_ms']),toFloat64OrZero(log_attributes['response.origin_time']))) AS max_ms,countIf(positionCaseInsensitive(event_message,'timeout')>0 OR log_attributes['parsed.sql_state_code']='57014') AS timeout_records,min(timestamp) AS first_record,max(timestamp) AS last_record FROM logs GROUP BY source ORDER BY source
